description: Batch final: Agro 4.0 e Prof. Geografina (dois estágios), mais Professora Ciência (estágio 2 apenas — folha já existe).
instructions: Para cada personagem, verifique se sheet_stage_done é true:
- Se true: pule o Estágio 1 e vá direto para o Estágio 2 usando chars_dir\sheet_output como referência.
- Se false ou ausente: execute os dois estágios em sequência.
ESTÁGIO 1 — Folha de personagens (se sheet_stage_done não for true):
1. Leia o hq_reference para identificar visualmente o personagem
2. Use o sheet_prompt para gerar uma folha de personagens limpa (3 poses, fundo branco)
ATENÇÃO: gere APENAS o personagem descrito, em poses isoladas no fundo branco.
NÃO gere infográficos, mapas, cartazes, diagramas ou qualquer elemento editorial.
1. Use chars_dir\[sheet_output] como imagem de referência
3. Gere o portrait e remova o fundo (#00ff00)
Se o personagem tiver portrait_output_2: salve o mesmo arquivo com ambos os nomes.

characters.name: Agro 4.0
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Compact yellow/golden agricultural robot with wheels, sensor arms, and chest display — appears throughout the HQ as the tech mascot
characters.sheet_prompt:
Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — TECNOLOGIA AGROPECUÁRIA' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show Agro 4.0 — a compact friendly yellow/golden agricultural robot (#F59E0B) — in 3 poses side by side:
1) TRABALHANDO: rolling forward on wheels/treads, one sensor arm extended, determined face on display
2) EXPLICANDO: stopped, chest display showing crop data, one arm pointing upward, friendly expression
3) COMEMORANDO: both arms raised in success, display showing green checkmark, joyful expression
Yellow/golden compact body, sturdy wheeled base, robotic arms, antenna. Labels below each pose. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, Brazilian educational comic style.

characters.name: Prof. Geografina
characters.key_identity_in_hq: Woman ~45, dark skin, large BRIGHT YELLOW round glasses (her most distinctive feature), curly gray-streaked hair in loose bun with tiny Brazilian flags, colorful patchwork quilt vest, pointer with small globe on tip
characters.sheet_prompt:
Character reference sheet titled 'FOLHA DE PERSONAGENS — PROF. GEOGRAFINA' for a Brazilian children's educational comic. White background. Show Prof. Geografina — a woman approximately 45 years old, dark brown skin, LARGE BRIGHT YELLOW round glasses (signature feature!), curly gray-streaked hair in a loose bun with tiny miniature Brazilian flags tucked in, colorful patchwork quilt vest (green/yellow/blue/red squares) over white shirt, carries a pointer stick with a small globe on the tip — in 3 poses side by side:
1) ENSINANDO: holding globe-pointer up, enthusiastic smile, one eyebrow raised
2) ORGULHOSA: arms crossed, proud warm smile, small Brazilian flag pin visible on vest
3) PERGUNTANDO: leaning slightly forward, one finger raised, glasses slightly tilted, warm questioning look
Labels below each pose. Bold outlines, flat cel-shading, vibrant colors, Brazilian educational comic style.
